pages.title: Snagem Guild | Pokemon Roleplay Community & Forums
pages.description: Join the Snagem Guild, a free Pokemon roleplay community with custom story forums, missions, battles, and a living world of Shadow Pokemon. Start your journey.

pages.title: About Us | Snagem Guild Pokemon Roleplay Community
pages.description: Learn what the Snagem Guild is about: a long-running Pokemon roleplay community with story forums, a trainer dashboard, missions, challenges, and guild events.

pages.title: The Great Snagem Library | Pokemon Roleplay Guides
pages.description: Browse the Snagem Library: Pokedex, battle guides, Shadow Pokemon lore, forum how-tos, house rules and policies, and answers about our Pokemon roleplay community.

pages.title: The Guild Blog | Pokemon Roleplay Stories & Updates
pages.description: Stories, dev updates and guides from the Snagem Guild Pokemon roleplay community. Read about our forums, events, Shadow Pokemon lore and more.

pages.title: Announcements & Updates | Snagem Guild
pages.description: Development updates and news from the Snagem Guild. See what is new across our Pokemon roleplay forums, trainer dashboard, and community features.

pages.title: The Mission Vault | Pokemon Roleplay Missions
pages.description: Pick up a mission from the Vault and open a roleplay thread. Track objectives, defeat encounters, and earn rewards in the Snagem Guild's Pokemon roleplay world.

pages.title: Research: Become a Master | Snagem Guild
pages.description: Take on Hybrid, Channeler, Fossil, and Mega research paths. Earn master clearances and unlock rare powers in the Snagem Guild Pokemon roleplay community.

pages.title: The Colosseum | Pokemon Battles & Training
pages.description: Train your team, battle rivals, and climb the ladder in the Colosseum, the battle and training hub of the Snagem Guild Pokemon roleplay community.

pages.title: Gyms & Island Trials | Snagem Guild
pages.description: Challenge gym leaders, take on Alola island trials, and climb the rematch ladder in the Snagem Guild's Pokemon roleplay challenge system.

pages.title: Ghastly Gambling Casino | Snagem Guild
pages.description: Trade Snag Coins for Gengar Tokens and try your luck at the guild casino. Games, prizes, and spooky fun in the Snagem Pokemon roleplay community.

pages.title: The Snag List & Weekly Activities | Snagem Guild
pages.description: Complete the weekly Snag List, farm berries, and fish at the pond. Weekly activities and rewards in the Snagem Guild Pokemon roleplay community.

pages.title: The Snag Mall | Item Shop | Snagem Guild
pages.description: Spend your Snag Coins at the Snag Mall. Poke Balls, medicine, held items, fishing rods, and more for your Pokemon roleplay adventures in the Snagem Guild.
